title: Invite token payload
description: The JSON object inside an invite token psw1.BASE64URL. Home: file 16, section 7.1. The pin k is the SHA256: fingerprint of the Ed25519 key of the coordinator (D-129).
$comment: s and w are base64url of 16 bytes with no padding (22 characters). ready.swarm of file 04 carries the bytes of w as 32 hex.

fingerprint.description: The SHA256: fingerprint form of pod_identity (D-129).
